recipes.label: Turbo
recipes.purpose: Fast photoreal still — a draft engine, never a default
recipes.qualities: FLUX.2 turbo Q4 + LoRA, 6 step. BFL non-commercial.
recipes.popup: Draft still, opt-in. Fast photoreal. ~20 GiB. Family table, comps — not for publishing.

recipes.label: Klein
recipes.purpose: Cheap/fast draft when you want to try an idea.
recipes.qualities: FLUX.2 Klein 4B NVFP4. Small, sketchy, quick.
recipes.popup: Cheap draft. ~10 GiB. Use to try a composition before Turbo or Max.

recipes.label: SDXL
recipes.purpose: Open/legacy still when you need something publishable.
recipes.qualities: SDXL 1.0. Lower quality than Flux. Open license.
recipes.popup: Open still, lower quality, publishable. ~10 GiB.

recipes.label: Max
recipes.purpose: Quality still when Turbo is not enough.
recipes.qualities: FLUX.2 max fp8 + turbo LoRA, 8 step. 36 GiB: may refuse when the card is packed.
recipes.popup: Quality still. ~36 GiB. May refuse if the card is packed. BFL internal.

recipes.label: Qwen
recipes.purpose: Apache still. No Lightning LoRA on disk — slower than the name suggests.
recipes.qualities: Qwen-Image 2512 fp8. Apache 2.0. No Lightning LoRA.
recipes.popup: Apache still. ~30 GiB. No Lightning LoRA on disk — not a speed pick.

recipes.label: Edit
recipes.purpose: Edit the current still or an attached photo.
recipes.qualities: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511. Needs a still. Product-accuracy path.
recipes.popup: Photo edit. Attach / current still required. ~30 GiB. Apache 2.0.

recipes.label: WAN
recipes.purpose: Short clip from a still (~2 s @ 16 fps).
recipes.qualities: WAN 2.2 image-to-video. Needs a still. Open.
recipes.popup: Image-to-video ~2 s. Needs a still. ~22 GiB. Not text-to-video.

recipes.label: LTX
recipes.purpose: Local text-to-video (~2 s @ 24 fps). No still required.
recipes.qualities: LTX-2.3 nvfp4 + distilled LoRA. Gemma encoder is the 5-shard folder via LTXVGemmaCLIPModelLoader. API graph ltx23-nvfp4-t2v.json. First clip looked at 2026-08-24: ltx23_00001_.mp4 kitchen loaf + steam, not beige.
recipes.popup: Text-to-video ~2 s. Gemma folder + nvfp4. ~25 GiB. Look at the mp4.
recipes.license: Lightricks LTX community licence: commercial use allowed under $10M annual revenue, outputs labelled AI-generated, no competing product
recipes.note: LTX-2.3 weights come from Lightricks' own repository under its community licence; commercial use is allowed under $10M annual revenue, every output is labelled AI-generated, no competing product. Opt-in; never downloaded by the house or a pack (the User 2026-10-08).

recipes.label: LTX FLF
recipes.purpose: First-last-frame clip for hub-legal pose loops/slides. Same hub PNG both ends = Law 1 loop; different hubs = slide.
recipes.qualities: LTX-2.3 nvfp4 + distilled LoRA. Official 2.3 FLF knobs (template video_ltx2_3_flf2v): LTXVAddGuideAdvanced strength 0.7, CRF 25 (higher CRF = more motion). Wall size 736×384, not the template's 768×512. Pose-flourish probe — not a volume mint until Vera looks.
recipes.popup: Hub-legal clip. first_image + last_image = hub PNGs. strength 0.7 / CRF 25. ~25 GiB. Look at the mp4.
recipes.license: Lightricks LTX community licence: commercial use allowed under $10M annual revenue, outputs labelled AI-generated, no competing product
recipes.note: LTX-2.3 weights come from Lightricks' own repository under its community licence; commercial use is allowed under $10M annual revenue, every output is labelled AI-generated, no competing product. Opt-in; never downloaded by the house or a pack (the User 2026-10-08).

recipes.label: LTX 2.5 FLF
recipes.purpose: Official LTX-2.5 first-last-frame (video_ltx2_5_flf2v knobs). Hub-legal pose loops.
recipes.qualities: Distilled INT8+convrot transformer + Gemma 4 CLIP (type ltxv) + 2.5 conv video VAE. Comfy v0.34.2 mints (2026-08-30). Guide strength 0.7, LTXVPreprocess 25. Wall size 736×384 × 97. API graph ltx25-flf2v.json. Probe — not body kit.
recipes.popup: Official 2.5 FLF knobs. first_image + last_image = hub PNGs. ~39 GiB weights. Look at the mp4.
recipes.note: LTX weights are not shipped and never downloaded by krew: the owner fetches them from Lightricks' own repository under its community licence and turns the recipe on (opt_in: false) themselves. An LTX output is marked AI-generated (ai_generated in the order, AI-GENERATED.txt beside the files).

recipes.label: LTX 2.5
recipes.purpose: LTX-2.5 first-frame only. 15 s life loops (eyes, mouse). Wrap the tail onto the hub after. Not FLF.
recipes.qualities: Same distilled INT8 transformer + Gemma 4 + conv VAE as ltx25-flf2v. One LoadImage, one LTXVAddGuide at frame 0 strength 0.7. 736×384 × 361 (15 s @ 24, 8n+1). Official I2V is one start image.
recipes.popup: LTX 2.5 first-only, ~15 s from the current still. Wrap the tail after. ~30 GiB.
recipes.note: LTX weights are not shipped and never downloaded by krew: the owner fetches them from Lightricks' own repository under its community licence and turns the recipe on (opt_in: false) themselves. An LTX output is marked AI-generated (ai_generated in the order, AI-GENERATED.txt beside the files).

_doc: The shipped recipes: one entry per ComfyUI API-format workflow under plugins/krew-comfy/workflows (sdxl, qwen-image-2512, qwen-edit-2511, wan22-i2v ship; the rest need your own workflow files). The default still is the first commercial-OK recipe that is wired (qwen-image-2512, else sdxl). A recipe with opt_in: true is never a default and never a studio chip until you set it false yourself: its licence (BFL non-commercial, LTX-2 Community) does not allow publishing (the owner 2026-10-08).
